name: cosmos-qa
description: Orquestacion de los gates de calidad de Cosmos. Ver QA_PLAN.md.

scripts.qa: npm run qa:back && npm run qa:front && npm run qa:app
scripts.test: npm run test:back && npm run test:front && npm run test:app
scripts.lint: npm run lint:back && npm run lint:front && npm run lint:app
scripts.lint:baseline: node tools/lint-ratchet.mjs cosmos-back --update && node tools/lint-ratchet.mjs cosmos-front --update && node tools/lint-ratchet.mjs cosmos-app --update
scripts.audit: node tools/audit-gate.mjs cosmos-back && node tools/audit-gate.mjs cosmos-front && node tools/audit-gate.mjs cosmos-app
